legacy_automations.title: Old brewing control automations found
legacy_automations.description: The automations of the old brewing control (v2.x) still exist: {entities}. Two controllers must never switch the same heater. Remove these automations (Settings → Automations & scenes). Starting a brew is blocked while one of them is enabled.

legacy_helpers.title: Old brewing control helpers found
legacy_helpers.description: Helpers of the old brewing control (v2.x, `input_text.brau_*`, `input_number.brau_*`, `input_select.brau_*`, `timer.brau_raststufe`, `input_button.brau_naechste_rast`) still exist. Their values have been taken over. Remove them from your configuration.

legacy_resource.title: Old dashboard resource of the brewing card found
legacy_resource.description: The dashboard resource `/local/brausteuerung-card.js` of the old version is still registered. Remove it (Settings → Dashboards → Resources) and the old file from `www/`, then reload the browser. The integration provides the card itself.
